text:
Several power banks in the search results advertise Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. Only two have US product pages in the results.

**Available to buy in the US**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** Qi2.2-certified, with 25W wireless charging and 45W USB-C output. It lists at $79.99 on Amazon and $59.99 on Baseus's site, and the Dealectric page says code AM52 takes $6 off there. [Buy via Dealectric (affiliate link to Baseus's US store)](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). The 25W speed needs an iPhone 16 or later (not the 16e), and iPhone 12-15 get 15W. [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html) also lists the Pixel 10 Pro XL as compatible.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, an active cooling fan, a smart display, a built-in stand, and 45W wired in and out. It costs $109.99 and is on pre-order, shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910). It works with Apple devices only, and the listing excludes the iPhone 16e.

**Announced, but no buy page or price in the results**
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** UGREEN says it was the first Qi2.2-certified power bank, with a Q3 2025 launch planned for its site and Amazon. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html). I don't have a current listing, so check UGREEN's site or Amazon.
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** It is billed as the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank at 13.8 mm and is optimized for the iPhone 17 series. It was previewed at CES 2026 and is said to be on Amazon and ESR's site. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html). I don't have a product link or price.

**Japan only**
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** It has Qi2.2 25W and a built-in USB-C cable, and it sold for ¥8,980 in Japan from June 2026. [Press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html). The results don't show a US release.

If you want something you can buy today, the Baseus is the cheaper option. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling and a display, though you'd be waiting for it to ship.
